discord.description: Tutti voice — read, post and moderate Discord messages from agents

token.description: Discord bot token. Falls back to the DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN environment variable.

email.description: Tutti voice — read and send email via IMAP IDLE + SMTP; shared client for @tuttiai/inbox

password.description: Account password. Falls back to the protocol-specific environment variable, then TUTTI_EMAIL_PASSWORD.

secure.description: TLS preference. IMAP defaults to true, matching port 993. SMTP depends on the port: 465 is true, 587 and 25 are false and use STARTTLS.

password.description: Account password. Falls back to the protocol-specific environment variable, then TUTTI_EMAIL_PASSWORD.

secure.description: TLS preference. IMAP defaults to true, matching port 993. SMTP depends on the port: 465 is true, 587 and 25 are false and use STARTTLS.

from.description: Default From header on outbound mail, e.g. "Tutti Bot <bot@example.com>".

maxBodyChars.description: Character limit on an inbound text body. Defaults to 1000000, roughly 1 MB.

redactRawText.description: Run SecretsManager.redact on dispatched text. Defaults to true.

filesystem.description: Filesystem voice for Tutti — read, write, and search files

github.description: Tutti voice — interact with GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, branches, and commits

token.description: GitHub personal access token. Falls back to the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable.

mcp.description: MCP bridge voice for Tutti — wrap any MCP server as a Tutti voice

server.description: MCP server command, e.g. 'npx @playwright/mcp'. EXECUTED AS A CHILD PROCESS. Treat granting this as equivalent to granting shell access.

args.description: Additional CLI arguments appended after the server command.

env.description: Extra environment variables passed to the server process.

name.description: Override the voice name. Defaults to mcp-<server-name>.

playwright.description: Tutti voice — control a browser like a human for QA and automation

headless.description: Run the browser in headless mode. Defaults to true.

slowMo.description: Milliseconds to wait between actions. For debugging only.

timeout.description: Default action timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.

postgres.description: Tutti voice — query and inspect a PostgreSQL database from agents (read-only by default)

connection_string.description: Postgres connection string, e.g. postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db. Falls back to DATABASE_URL, then POSTGRES_URL.

statement_timeout_ms.description: Per-statement timeout enforced server-side, stopping a runaway query from hanging the agent. Defaults to 30000.

max_connections.description: Maximum simultaneous connections in the pool. Defaults to 5, because agents typically run sequential queries and managed Postgres caps connections aggressively.

rag.description: Tutti voice — retrieval-augmented generation: ingest, search, and manage a knowledge base

collection.description: Identifier for the knowledge collection this voice operates on. Required.

max_batch_size.description: Override the internal maximum batch size. Rarely needed.

base_url.description: Override the base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

max_batch_size.description: Override the internal maximum batch size. Rarely needed.

base_url.description: Override the base URL. Defaults to https://api.voyageai.com/v1.

model.description: Model name recognised by the server, e.g. "nomic-embed-text". Required.

max_batch_size.description: Override the internal maximum batch size. Rarely needed.

base_url.description: Base URL of the local server, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434. Required.

allow_private.description: SECURITY. Permits a base_url the SSRF guard would refuse: loopback, private IPv4 ranges and link-local. Defaults to false. This disables the check entirely for this provider, not only for loopback, so the cloud instance metadata endpoint 169.254.169.254 becomes reachable. Set it only when base_url is a constant you control, never when it derives from agent or user input.

connection_string.description: Postgres connection string. Falls back to the RAG_PG_URL environment variable. At least one must be set.

default_top_k.description: Default top-K returned by search_knowledge when a call does not specify one.

chunk_size.description: Maximum characters per chunk during ingestion.

hyde.description: Enable HyDE query rewriting for search_knowledge. Requires an llm callback passed to RagVoice in code, and is ignored otherwise, so it has no effect when set from a stored document alone.

sandbox.description: Sandbox voice for Tutti — secure code execution for TypeScript, Python, and Bash

allowed_languages.description: Restrict which languages the agent may execute. All three are available when omitted.

allowed_packages.description: Package allowlist for install_package. Every package is allowed when omitted.

timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock timeout for a code execution. Defaults to 30000.

max_file_size_bytes.description: Largest file write_file will accept, in bytes. Defaults to 1048576.

env.description: Extra environment variables merged into child process environments.

install_timeout_ms.description: Timeout for a package install. Defaults to 60000.

slack.description: Tutti voice — read, post and moderate Slack messages from agents

token.description: Slack bot token (xoxb-...). Falls back to the SLACK_BOT_TOKEN environment variable.

stripe.description: Tutti voice — full Stripe API coverage from agents (customers, products, prices, payments, subscriptions, invoices)

api_key.description: Stripe secret API key (sk_test_... or sk_live_...). Falls back to the STRIPE_SECRET_KEY environment variable. Every destructive tool in this voice moves real money on a live key.

telegram.description: Tutti voice — read, post and moderate Telegram messages from agents; shared bot client for @tuttiai/inbox

token.description: Telegram bot token. Falls back to the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN environment variable.

twitter.description: Tutti voice — post, read, search and manage Twitter/X content from agents
unexpressed_rules: Write access needs all four of api_key, api_secret, access_token and access_token_secret, or none of them. Supplying some but not all is refused.

bearer_token.description: App-only bearer token. Grants read-only access to the v2 API.

api_key.description: OAuth 1.0a app consumer key. Required for write operations.

api_secret.description: OAuth 1.0a app consumer secret. Required for write operations.

access_token.description: OAuth 1.0a user access token. Required for write operations.

access_token_secret.description: OAuth 1.0a user access token secret. Required for write operations.

web.description: Web voice for Tutti — search, fetch pages, and read sitemaps with Brave, Serper, or DuckDuckGo

provider.description: Search provider. When omitted the voice auto-selects from the available API keys, preferring Brave, then Serper, then DuckDuckGo.

cache.description: Enable the LRU result cache. Defaults to true. Disable when freshness matters more than latency.

max_results.description: Default number of results from web_search. The agent may still override per call. Defaults to 5.

rate_limit.description: Per-tool rate limit shared by every tool in the voice.

timeout_ms.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 5000.

whatsapp.description: Tutti voice — send and receive WhatsApp messages via Meta's Cloud API; shared webhook server for @tuttiai/inbox

phoneNumberId.description: WhatsApp Business phone number ID. Required.

accessToken.description: Graph API access token. Falls back to WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN.

verifyToken.description: Webhook verification token. Falls back to WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN.

appSecret.description: App secret used to verify webhook signatures. Falls back to WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET.

bodyLimit.description: Maximum webhook request body size in bytes.

rateLimit.description: Per-source-IP rate limit at the webhook boundary. Defaults to 100 requests per 60s per IP. Pass false only behind a trusted upstream that already rate-limits.
